policy: Research-only. No production writes and no astronomical anomaly claims without independent evidence.

provenance.inventory_source: Connected GitHub search user:Hawkar-usls, 51 repos as observed 2026-11-21

scope.revision: Capture each repo HEAD SHA before parsing; default branch only. Does NOT cover all historical branches, Git LFS binary payloads, private repos, or files > 1 MiB.

extraction.code: Numeric tokens parsed with ast/tokenizer for Python, JSON scalar walk and regexp for other supported source formats. Values keep file path, SHA, line and context; hashes/IDs/strings excluded from code-num tokens. Missing/invalid files listed separately.
extraction.explicit_candidate: RA and Dec must be both present in named coordinate sibling fields or in declared SkyCoord constructs. Unit and frame must be retained; equatorial RA in degrees must be in [0,360), Dec [-90,90].
extraction.vector_candidate: ICRS or frame-declared unit vector with x,y,z convertible via atan2 and asin; frame-less vectors ineligible.
extraction.time_based: Altitude/azimuth only convertible when site latitude, longitude and observation UTC are in same bound experiment; otherwise not a unique celestial direction.
extraction.speculative: Do not convert unpaired numbers to stars. Optional deterministic adjacent numeric-pair sky projections reported as purely synthetic and evaluated under multiple-testing nulls; not physical direction evidence.

frozen_checks.astronomy_catalog: External independent catalog query SIMBAD (if reachable); fail closed on network/timeouts. Bright-star static control may validate angle math, but isn't independent observational verification.
frozen_checks.control_design: Matched random ICRS directions with fixed seed 20261121 and identical query/radius; report trial counts and no raw success if independent catalog missing.
frozen_checks.inference: Posthoc direction to catalog object is not physical association; no 'technosignature', 'probe', or planet inference from proximity; correct for multiple comparisons.

private_repos_note: The standalone GitHub Actions token for Janus-Cosmos does not grant cross-repository private-read access. Explicitly report private repos not examined.
